I recently bought this product. While I like it, i was shocked to look online after leaving the store to see it is much much less expensive through the actual brand. Or virtually any other place than ulta. Buy elsewhere. This price gouging actually turned me off of ulta.
Excellent product will recomand to anyone .use it as designed.

avis.titre: Expensive, NOT as effective as C+E+Ferulic Acid...
avis.texte: I purchased this ONCE from Ulta a few years back. I found this product to be unremarkable. I then shifted to serums that include Vitamin C+E+Ferulic Acid, which has greater benefits than C alone but is much more expensive. I eventually tired of the high cost of all these products. I now just make my own C+E+Ferulic Acid! Most women don't realize that the combination of C+E+Ferulic Acid is the key to the best results. Vitamin C is good as an antioxidant, it brightens the skin, reduces hyperpigmentation, and stimulates collagen production. Vitamin E is also an antioxidant that moisturizes and nourishes the skin's barrier to protect the skin from environmental damage and has anti-aging properties. Ferulic Acid is a plant-based antioxidant that stabilizes Vitamin C and Vitamin E by enhancing their effectiveness and extending their shelf life of the product. Either way, I will never go back to buying any of these products; my DIY C+E+Ferulic is superior at a very low cost!

I just received on a special order. It's nice, easily absorbs. As others have said, the pump doesn't work. I use a wand to get it out of the bottle. I can feel it's tightening. I hope it helps. I'll update

avis.titre: Decent product, lovely smell, just pricey.
avis.texte: I've been using this for a few weeks now, and out of the 15+ vitamin C serums I've ever used this is in the top 5. It's effective, it absorbs quickly, and it smells great (smells like fresh orange to me). I feel like it has helped my fine lines the most, it's just okay for discoloration. The reason it only gets 3 stars is first, the price. Yikes. There are other vitamin C serums out there that are $50 or less and work just as good. Second, this pills like CRAZY. I normally use my vitamin C in the morning, but this does not play well with other products. I've tried several SPF's with this and they all pill terribly. For me, it's not a huge deal, I just use this product at night instead and have swapped my nightime serum to daytime use, but it's definitely annoying considering the price of this. If you're looking to splurge and can afford it, this is a nice product. Otherwise, there are better and cheaper options out there.

I've been using this serum for about 6 weeks now and I am really impressed by how much this has lightned the dark spots and discoloration on my face. I haven't had any irritation with this product at all and it doesn't have a bad smell like most products with ferulic acid. My only complaint is that this serum will pill with other products. I tend to only use sunscreen on top of this and even then it can pill up. I have found that if I mix a few drops of the pycnogenol serum from the Ordinary in with this it does help keep it from pilling. Overall, I am very pleased with how well this actually works. My skin looks amazing. My complexion is much brighter and even. I just think for the price, there shouldn't be any issues with the formula.
Even though this serum smell great and skin felt really soft right away, my skin did not absorbed this product. It clumped even when i tried it alone, with same brand moisturizer. I had to return it.
This product does just what it says. Lightens age spots and conditions my face and neck. Use it as directed and you won't be disappointed.
I think I'm allergic to it. My face got itchy and red just after two days of use.

avis.titre: This is always my first cleanse

Fair skin. Tons of sun. It's showing. I'm 60. Tried other dark spot products with ok results. Kinda worked within a few weeks but hit a wall. This has almost wiped them out and fast, and omg, GLOWING, FIRM skin! Best skin product I've ever used!

Plus it has ferulic which I love since it's an antioxidant and anti aging!!! I had bad discoloration and sun damage I'm on my 3rd bottle and I get so many compliments on my skin!! I wouldn't normally be so quick to write a review on a product, but this is worthy of an outstanding review. I have seen a difference in a week. No lie. Some spots have disappeared and the overall even complexion is a wow factor. Highly recommend.

avis.titre: Not suited for Oily Skin, but works.
avis.texte: I have oily skin, and my skin gets oiler once I apply the serum, even oiler when I follow up with their brightening sunscreen. My face just felt so thick and oily, if that makes sense. However, I did notice that my skin was brighter when I used the product vs when I discontinued the product. Might work well for people with dry to normal skin. :)

I just started using this product in the last week. It does sting against my skin ever so briefly, but it does not damage it. What I can't seem to get past is the odor of the product. I have not used long enough to know if it has any improved my skin, but the fragrance is off-putting to me.

avis.titre: Removed Dark Spots AND MY SKIN!!!!!!!
avis.texte: I had some sort of allergic reaction to at least one of the ingredients in this product. I do not have sensitive skin. I have and continue to use many Perricone products,which I generally love. This product however caused me to have 2nd degree burns and swelling over my face..with a concentration of the burns around my eyes and mouth. I've been using only coconut oil on my face for the last 5 days, while it is healing. My face is sort of like one big scab!! This stuff took off at least a layer of my skin. I patch tested it later on my neck, behind my ears and my arms, but had no reaction. I do layer my products and was hoping that maybe this just reacted to one of the other products. However, today, stupidly, mostly because I wanted to love this product, I put a small amount on my face, in front of my ear over a dark spot. In about an hour,I developed stinging and redness in this area, but it also spread closer to my under eye, which is not where I put the cream. I am not allergic to vitamin C or ferulic acid,because I've been using Skin Ceuticals for over a year now...I waited forever to try this product...and bought it last week with the 50% off skincare sale. I am over 60 and have been using skincare since college. I have used a zillion products over the years and there's only one other time this happened to me. It was with Derma Doctors Kaduka Plum vitamin C serum. After comparing ingredients, I see they both use the same form of vitamin C- 3-O-Ethyl Ascorbic Acid. Skin C

avis.titre: Best Vitamin C Serum Out There
avis.texte: Where to start with the Pros of this serum!! Yes, it's pricey - but you do get 2 oz. I have tried THEM ALL. I will look no further. After 2 mos use, my 51 normal/dry PLUS acne prone skin has never looked better. Please note: this is a serum with actives - on dryer days I combine with a Hyluronic acid serum. Highly recommend!

I am in love with the Perricone MD Vitamin C Ester CCC+ Ferulic Brightening Complex 20% Serum. In the two and half weeks that I have been using this serum my skin has completely changed. It is brighter and it has a glow to it that I noticed within just 3 days of use twice daily. After the past two weeks my skin has begun to truly improve, the lines and wrinkles around my eyes and on my forehead have completely softened and in all honesty around my my eyes my wrinkles are not even noticeable. I love the Original Perricone MD Vitamin C Ester but this one with the CCC Ferulic Brightening Complex 20% serum is even better because it goes to work so quickly with real results. My skin had no bad reaction and I am going to continue to use it and will be repurchasing. Thanks for the complimentary sample.
